content_zh:
若不缠上白布，是无论如何也遮不住的！
梁心铭没有羞涩，也没有刻意遮掩自己的前胸，坦坦荡荡地抬起修长玉腿，迈入盆中，坐了下去。
李惠娘表现完全不同，她仔细将大门和房门都关严实了，将窗帘遮得严丝合缝，才掀开床头帷幔走进来，回身再将帷幔遮掩好，低声道：“这罪受的！”一面蹲下，替她搓洗，并按摩揉捏脊背，放松被捆绑三天的胸部。
梁心铭淡声道：“谁不受罪！”
那些参加乡试的男人不受罪吗？
他们倒是真男人，不用费事装，可是看他们今天从贡院出来的狼狈形象，她都替他们感到难受。
惠娘低声道：“我怕你……”怕她煎熬不下去。
梁心铭道：“莫担心，我很好。”帷幔遮蔽的狭窄空间内，热气蒸腾，她的双眼更加迷蒙深邃，声音却如常，并没有因为脱了衣裳、又在室内，就换一副脆弱模样。
惠娘不再扫她兴，转而带笑问：“今天考得怎样？”其实早看出她考得好，不过故意问，想引她开心罢了。
梁心铭亦带笑道：“很好。”
惠娘很开心，又埋怨道：“你那时候不该买发簪。”
太狂，容易惹人注意。
梁心铭道：“我高兴。”
口气带着淡淡的坚持。
她不喜欢被困住的感觉，一文钱难倒英雄汉，她偏要视金钱若无物，而不是被金钱阻滞。再者，她也想让惠娘开心。哪怕她们是假夫妻，她也要尽可能地让惠娘感到：梁心铭依然在她身边，呵护、照顾她。
惠娘知她脾气，也不跟她争，专心伺候她洗澡。
梁心铭爱洗澡，讲究干净是其一，最重要的是想让白天被束缚的胸口松快松快。这东西天生属于女人，不是你把它捆住，它就会听话的。捆住它，自己难受不说，一些丰胸的食物也不敢多吃，比和尚还苦。和尚最起码能吃豆腐，而梁心铭连豆腐也不敢多吃。因为黄豆、猪蹄、木瓜等东西都是丰胸催乳的食物。可她又要用功，没有足够的营养也不行。
唉，这才是要命的问题！
洗罢，依旧要缠住胸口。
这是为了谨慎起见，若等明早再缠，倘或半夜出现什么突发状况，来不及缠怎么办？

梁心铭绝不容许这种情形出现，除了生理问题无法消除外，平日里她就当自己“是”男人，而不是在“装”男人；李惠娘就是她的妻子，而不是假扮的妻子。
开始，李惠娘总会说：“傻丫头，假的就是假的。”有些事，假夫君可做不来。时间一长，李惠娘也糊涂了。梁心铭撑起了这个家，在她的维护下，李惠娘有种错觉：夫君真的没死，他们依旧生活在一起。
李惠娘一来贪恋并享受梁心铭的呵护，二来也防备梁心铭被人发现身份，因此看得夫君很紧，尤其不让任何女人靠近梁心铭，这造成了她善妒泼辣的形象。
梁心铭从不指责纠正她，如同一个宽厚的男人。
李惠娘想起今天回来时，豆腐西施看梁心铭的眼神，嘀咕道：“你这也太招人眼了。瞧那司马姑娘瞅得你！”
梁心铭微微一笑。
夜静了，小院也安静下来。
只有半月照在窗上。
次日凌晨，李惠娘比梁心铭更早起来，用昨晚剩下的鸡汤为她下了一碗面，还打了两个鸡蛋，伺候她吃了，才送她出门。那时，天色尚未大亮。
本来她一定要送梁心铭去贡院的，梁心铭说：“你送我去了，回来你一个人带着朝云，我还不放心呢。你听，街上好些人了，我一个男人怕什么。这两天你最好待在家里等我，哪儿也别去。”说到最后，她口气少有的郑重。
李惠娘神情一正，点头道：“是。真的万无一失吗？”后一句似乎是问梁心铭对这场考试的预期。
梁心铭道：“你就在家等好消息吧。”
李惠娘深吸一口气，很激动、很期盼。送梁心铭到门口，又叮嘱了许多话，看着她提着考篮走出竹竿巷，才回身掩上门，还插上了门插。
晨雾蒙蒙，梁心铭走上街头，街上已经许多人，有肩挑手挽或者推着小车卖菜卖各种小吃的，也有买东西的，有搭伴去市场一路闲话家长里短的……
正看着，忽发现人丛中有个熟悉的身影，推着车正在喊：“卖豆腐嘞——卖豆腐嘞——”清脆悦耳的声音回荡在晨雾弥漫的徽州古城内，极为动听。

content_en:
If you don't wrap it with a white cloth, you can't cover it at all!
Liang Xinming was not shy, nor did he deliberately cover his chest. He raised his slender legs openly, stepped into the basin, and sat down.
Li Huiniang's behavior was completely different. She carefully closed the door and the room door tightly, covered the curtains tightly, then opened the curtains on the bedside and walked in. She turned around and covered the curtains again, whispering: "You've suffered!" while squatting down, scrubbing her, and massaging her back to relax her chest, which had been tied up for three days.
Liang Xinming said quietly: "Who will not be punished!"
Are the men who took part in the provincial examination not guilty?
They were real men, so they didn't need to bother pretending, but seeing the mess they looked like when they came out of the Gongyuan today, she felt bad for them.
Huiniang whispered: "I'm afraid of you..." She was afraid that she wouldn't be able to endure the pain.
Liang Xinming said: "Don't worry, I'm fine." In the narrow space covered by the curtains, the heat was steaming. Her eyes became more misty and deep, but her voice was as usual. She didn't look fragile just because she took off her clothes and was indoors again.
Hui Niang no longer displeased her, but asked with a smile: "How was your test today?" In fact, she had already seen that she did well in the test, but she asked deliberately to make her happy.
Liang Xinming also said with a smile: "Very good."
Hui Niang was very happy and complained: "You shouldn't have bought hairpins at that time."
Too crazy and easily attracts attention.
Liang Xinming said: "I'm happy."
There was a hint of persistence in his tone.
She doesn't like the feeling of being trapped. A penny can stump a heroic man. She prefers to treat money as if it is nothing, rather than being held back by money. Furthermore, she also wanted to make Hui Niang happy. Even if they are a fake couple, she must try her best to make Huiniang feel that Liang Xinming is still by her side, protecting and taking care of her.
Hui Niang knew her temper and didn't argue with her. She concentrated on taking her bath.
Liang Xinming loves bathing, and one of the things she cares about is cleanliness. The most important thing is to relax her chest, which has been restrained during the day. This thing is born to be a woman. If you tie it up, it will be obedient. Not only did I feel uncomfortable when I tied it up, I also didn't dare to eat more breast-enhancing food, which was even more painful than a monk. At least a monk can eat tofu, but Liang Xinming doesn't even dare to eat too much tofu. Because soybeans, pig's trotters, papaya and other foods are breast enhancement and lactation foods. But she has to work hard, and it won't work without enough nutrition.
Alas, this is the fatal question!
After washing, you still have to wrap it around your chest.
This is just for the sake of caution. If we wait until tomorrow morning, what should we do if something unexpected happens in the middle of the night and we don’t have time to do so?
Liang Xinming will never allow this situation to occur. Except for the physical problems that cannot be eliminated, she usually regards herself as "being" a man instead of "pretending" to be a man; Li Huiniang is her wife, not pretending to be a wife.
At first, Li Huiniang would always say: "Silly girl, whatever is fake is just fake." There are some things that a fake husband can't do. As time passed, Li Huiniang became confused. Liang Xinming supported the family. Under her protection, Li Huiniang had the illusion that her husband was really not dead and they were still living together.
On the one hand, Li Huiniang was greedy and enjoyed Liang Xinming's care, and on the other hand, she was also wary of Liang Xinming's identity being discovered, so she watched her husband very closely, and especially did not let any woman get close to Liang Xinming, which created her image of being jealous and aggressive.
Liang Xinming never criticized or corrected her, just like a generous man.
Li Huiniang thought of the way Tofu Xishi looked at Liang Xinming when she came back today, and muttered: "You are too eye-catching. Look how much that Sima girl takes notice of you!"
Liang Xinming smiled slightly.
The night is quiet, and the small courtyard is also quiet.
Only the half moon shines on the window.
In the early morning of the next day, Li Huiniang got up earlier than Liang Xinming, made her a bowl of noodles with the leftover chicken soup from last night, and cracked two eggs for her to eat before sending her out. At that time, it was not bright yet.
Originally, she had to send Liang Xinming to Gongyuan, but Liang Xinming said, "Send me there."Now, I'm not worried about you taking Chao Yun alone when you come back. Listen, there are many people on the street. What am I afraid of as a man? You'd better stay home and wait for me these two days and don't go anywhere. "At the end of her speech, her tone was rare and solemn.
Li Huiniang's expression straightened, she nodded and said, "Yes. Is it really foolproof? "The latter sentence seems to be asking Liang Xinming about his expectations for this exam.
Liang Xinming said: "Just wait for the good news at home. "
Li Huiniang took a deep breath, very excited and looking forward to it. I walked Liang Xinming to the door and gave many more instructions. I watched her walk out of Bamboo Cane Alley with the exam basket in hand, then turned around and closed the door and inserted the door latch.
In the foggy morning, Liang Xinming walked onto the street. There were already many people on the street. Some were selling vegetables and snacks on their shoulders or pushing carts, some were shopping, and some were going to the market to chat with their parents...
As I was watching, I suddenly noticed a familiar figure in the crowd, pushing a cart and shouting: "Selling tofu - selling tofu -" The clear and sweet voice echoed in the ancient city of Huizhou filled with morning fog, which was very beautiful.
